final_reconstruction.details: The particles from both datasets were converted into star files using csparc2star from the PyEM suite for further processing in RELION v5.0.0b.

final_three_d_classification.details:
For Dataset 1, two rounds of heterogeneous refinement were performed using five classes.
Dataset 2 underwent eight rounds of heterogeneous refinement using five classes.

startup_model.details: Data for Ab initio reconstruction were obtained from the dataset after two rounds  2d classification.
startup_model.insilico_model: Ab initio reconstruction was used to create initial models for both datasets.

image_recording.details: Two dataset were collected and merged together during data processing.
